logs

02.aug.26 been making a LOT of progress. i beat some gay robots in the citadel (btw that boss fight was SO much fun!!!!) and then decided to backtrack to different areas of pharloom. and even got new upgrades like the high jump and the harpoon. i truly love this game so much. i have 53hrs on it and i am pretty sure i am only halfway done. while i love this game a lot i find the enemy rushes to be a bit... too much at times. i feel like most of them don't give up the same satisfaction as beating a boss. to me the best things of these games is the exploration, and the exploration itself can be quite the challenge. but then here i go going into a tiny room and yeah, beat 10 enemies of this biome. annoying as hell. at least i've found that the really annoying ones that i haven't beaten yet such as deep docks and bilewater aren't really That detrimental to my exploration. and i get that they are kind of the replacement of bosses but. there are some that i just cant. deep docks with the enemies that want to bomb you alive. and bilewater with the W O R M water + annoying ass enemies that i have NO FUN fighting. actually: bilewater has got to be the most evil place ever.

why are you putting an enemy rush and boss battle in the same fight ?!?!?!? thats EVIL. and if i die to the boss you want me to do the enemy rush again? FUCK BILEWATER i put a pin on that so i can go to it later but i just... can't right now. i'm ignoring that for now.

in other news, i've continued exploring the citadel and i am currently in the memorium part of it. very interesting how the place is a mix and match of previous places from below.

18.jul.26 one of the best single player experiences i've ever had. holy fucking shit. this is also another game that i love but also makes me suffer with it's difficulty. but you know what, that is is where most of the fun comes from. i thank god for the different crests in the game that let you change the moveset because while hornet's moveset is really cool and the diagonal jump is a bit handy at times... i DO NOT have the patience to use it when it comes to the platforming jumping sections of the game. SORRY. reaper crest 4ever.

i recently beat the last judge (took me 3 days but i did it yay) and while underworks was kind of crazy, i almost cried hearing the score when entering choral chambers like wow wow wow wow...

i will probably go back to bloodborne once i am done with silksong. i simply just can't handle two suffering games at the same time.
